salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-2 (c2-openai). Design Anything (multi-artifact design agent) and DesignAnything-Bench (228 tasks), GPT group only: the two systems run on GPT-5.6 Sol High, 'Design Anything (GPT)' (the authors' harness) and 'Codex (GPT)'. These are SYSTEM measures (harness + model), with images generated by gpt-image-2.5-sunburst (medium quality, 2K; outside the fit) and a common evaluator (not named in the text read). Every cell of the GPT rows of Tables 1 (added from the copy: the research file held Tables 6-13 only), 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13; the P/F/U task tallies of Table 7 and the median input tokens of Table 12 (orchestrating agent only) are kept as notes / usage. Effort 'high' written ('GPT-5.6 Sol receives reasoning effort high'); route not written (harness only); no money cost. DeepSeek, OpenDesign and JarvisHub rows are not OpenAI and not converted.
agent: convertisseur k-openai-2 (Sonnet 5.5), lecture ligne par ligne du fichier de recherche et de la copie
